factions.name: Thor
factions.title: Master of Edging
factions.rule: Once per turn, you may build a Mulch Path for just 1 Yggdrasil Turf.
factions.flavour: Straight lines. Crisp borders. Occasional thunder.

factions.name: Loki
factions.title: Turf Impostor
factions.rule: When you steal with the Mower, steal 2 cards instead of 1. You see their hand and choose. The TV only shows that 'something' went missing.
factions.flavour: That's not your lawn. That was never your lawn.

factions.name: Freya
factions.title: Floral Queen
factions.rule: If your own roll produces nothing for you, take 1 resource of your choice from the bank.
factions.flavour: Even dead soil owes her a favour.

factions.name: Hel
factions.title: Landscaping Manager
factions.rule: You never discard when a 7 is rolled. When other players discard, you take 1 of the discarded cards (your choice, once per 7).
factions.flavour: Everything ends up in her compost eventually.

factions.name: Odin
factions.title: All-Father of the Allotments
factions.rule: When you buy a Perk, draw 2. Keep 1 and put the other on the bottom of the deck.
factions.flavour: He gave an eye for wisdom. And a decent plot by the shed.

factions.name: Heimdall
factions.title: Neighbourhood Watch Captain
factions.rule: Your buildings still produce from a hex that has the Mower on it.
factions.flavour: He saw the Mower coming three postcodes away.

factions.name: Frigg
factions.title: Chair of the Residents' Association
factions.rule: You always trade with the bank at 3:1 for any resource, even without a Garden Centre.
factions.flavour: Minutes were taken. Motions were passed.

factions.name: Njord
factions.title: Water Feature Enthusiast
factions.rule: Whenever anyone rolls a 7, take 1 Hellfire Sprinkler from the bank before discards are checked.
factions.flavour: The pond pump has been running since the Bronze Age.

perkTypes.name: Gnome Militia
perkTypes.rule: Move Surtur's Lawn Mower to any hex and steal 1 random resource from a player next to it. Counts towards Largest Gnome Militia.
perkTypes.flavour: Tiny hats. Tiny pitchforks. Enormous grudges.

perkTypes.name: Mulch Spreader
perkTypes.flavour: Industrial grade. Smells of brimstone and bark.

perkTypes.name: Bumper Crop
perkTypes.rule: Take any 2 resources from the bank.
perkTypes.flavour: The end of the world has done wonders for the tomatoes.

perkTypes.name: Bin Day
perkTypes.rule: Name a resource. Every other player gives you all of that resource they hold.

perkTypes.name: Suburban Sinkhole
perkTypes.rule: Swap two adjacent hexes. Terrain, number token and the Mower (if present) move with their hex. Buildings and paths stay put.

perkTypes.name: Victory Point
perkTypes.rule: Worth 1 hidden Victory Point. Keep it secret. Reveal only when it wins you the game.

variants.name: Rune-Carved Water Feature
variants.flavour: Plays a tiny dirge on the hour.
